Asha: FYI CumulusAI (hardware + model partner) asked for a marketplace "quick-publish" stencil focused on quantized builds. Requirements: INT8/FP16 variants, provenance for quant artifacts (GGUF/ONNX), multi-arch images (arm64/x86), and a short legal checklist for redistribution. Need a POC and CI by next Wed. Who can take lead?
Roland: I can own the Terraform + packaging stencil. Plan a single module with a `quant_profile` var and `arch` selector. Example stub: ```terraform
module "cumulus_marketplace" {
  source       = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-stencils/cumulusai"
  region       = var.region
  quant_profile = var.quant_profile # int8 | fp16
  arch         = var.arch # arm64 | x86_64
}
```
Priya: I'll own CI and examples. CI should: 1) build multi-arch image, 2) generate SBOM, 3) verify quant artifact signatures, 4) run `ci/verify_quant.sh --profile int8 --arch arm64` against ephemeral infra.
Leah: Ops/Perf note  add a small sample app that uses a trimmed token length and a micro-benchmark harness so we can publish a short "lab numbers" blurb on the listing. Link to perf doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/perf.
Asha: Important: CumulusAI requires we include their quantization recipe file and provenance metadata in the module (checksums + signed metadata). They also asked we expose `model_store_uri` and `quant_recipe_uri` as module inputs.
Roland: Good call. We'll add outputs: `deployed_image`, `model_uri`, and `smoke_endpoint`. Also include `examples/quant-minimal` with a small Python client.
Priya: CI snippet I'll add to the workflow: ```yaml
- name: Verify quant artifacts
  run: |
    ./ci/verify_quant.sh --profile ${{ inputs.quant_profile }} --artifact $ARTIFACT_URI
```
Leah: verify_quant.sh should check file hashes, signature (cosign), and that quant metadata matches the declared `quant_profile`. Also run a 5-sample generation latency test.
LegalBot: Heads-up: partner redistribution requires an MSA addendum + confirmation that binary redistribution of quant artifacts is permitted. Ask CumulusAI for a redistrib clause and explicit trademark usage permission.
Asha: CumulusAI said they will provide a redistribution statement and a signed SBOM. I'll get legal to review the clause today.
partner-ops-bot: Created ticket P-3599: "CumulusAI quantized marketplace stencil + CI" assigned to @Roland, @Priya.
Priya: I'll scaffold GH Actions `marketplace/quant-smoke.yml` that: builds multi-arch image, runs SBOM, runs `ci/verify_quant.sh` (sig + hash), deploys to ephemeral acct, runs `scripts/micro_bench.py --samples 20`, then tears down.
Roland: For packaging README: include sections: Supported quant profiles, Compatibility matrix (model families + max seq len), How to verify signatures (cosign commands), and a short ops runbook for rollbacks.
Leah: Add a small compatibility table: 1) llm-small (seq512) -> int8 OK, 2) llm-medium (seq2048) -> prefer fp16 for stability. Also note KV cache behavior with quantized weights.
Asha: Let's sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to review PRs. If legal approves redistrib clause today, we can include the legal checklist in the README before merge. :thumbsup:
Roland: I'll open the initial scaffold PR tonight with `examples/quant-minimal` and `defaults.tfvars`.
Priya: I'll open the CI PR tomorrow morning and wire the ticket to the marketplace-publish pipeline.
LegalBot: Noted  please tag @legal when you have the redistrib language.
Asha: Thanks team. Quick ask: include a tiny `scripts/verify_quant.sh` usage in README so partners can run locally. E.g., `./scripts/verify_quant.sh --artifact model.gguf --sig model.gguf.sig --profile int8`.
